description: Pinned NVIDIA driver / CUDA / container stack for the GPU popV retrain batch. CPU Docker popV results must not be mixed into this batch.

nvidia_driver.install_note: Install from Ubuntu NVIDIA CUDA network repo or OEM cloud image; do not float to latest without re-pinning this file.

cuda_toolkit_host.note: Host CUDA toolkit is optional when using NVIDIA Container Toolkit + CUDA base image; driver must support CUDA 12.4.

nvidia_container_toolkit.configure: nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker && systemctl restart docker

isolation_from_cpu_batch.policy: GPU popV must re-run all three donor folds under the GPU batch root; never append GPU predictions into the CPU three-fold checkpoint tree.
